he.text: וְאַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד׃ תְּהִי־נָא אָזְנְךָ קַשֶּׁבֶת וְעֵינֶיךָ פְתוּחוֹת לִשְׁמוֹעַ אֶל תְּפִלַּת עֲבָדֶיךָ עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃ רַחֲמֶיךָ רַבִּים יְיָ כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ חַיֵּנוּ׃

en.text: But thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness. Now we beseech thee, let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servants, thy people Israel. Great are thy tender mercies, O Lord, quicken us according to thy judgments.
